text:
Done. Commit `05fffb0ec` in the worktree.

1. `public/framework/core/List/doc/architecture.md`: 75 lines, 10 decisions, all checked against `List.js`.
2. `⚠` code mismatches: the readme says `class List extends Events(Object)` and lists a `set()` method. The code is `extends Item` (Item is `Events(Object)`), and `set()` comes from `Item.apply()`. The decisions doc still says "zero imports", which is also stale. I left the readme and `decisions.md` alone, as the fence requires.
3. Also changed: the readme's `## More` line now links the architecture doc, and `page.js` notes read `architecture decisions`. `node --check` passes on `page.js`.

core/Sidebar: `doc/architecture.md` written and committed as `6c1d18984`, along with its readme `More` line and the `architecture` entry in `page.js` notes.

- **File:** `public/framework/core/Sidebar/doc/architecture.md`, 76 lines.
- **⚠ mismatches:**
  - The decisions file says the width key lives in `Page.Store`; the code uses `Page.Prefs`.
  - `reveal()` falls back to `location.pathname`, so "no view compares `window.location`" only holds while a Router exists.
  - The chevron `›` decision is not in `Sidebar.css` or `ux/Tree`, so I left it out.

The 37 `files.jsonl` edits in the worktree were not mine, so I did not commit them.

- **File:** `public/framework/ext/highlight/doc/architecture.md`, 73 lines. Committed as `fd9f94888` in the worktree, along with the readme `More` line and the `architecture` entry in `page.js` notes.
- **Code mismatches (⚠):** none. I checked each decision against `highlight.js`, `highlight.css`, `page.js` and `util/source/source.js`, and all of them hold today.
- **Census:** `ArchitectureCensus.mjs --decisions ext/highlight` returned no decision lines, so the entries come from `doc/decisions.md`, `choice.md`, `hooks.md` and `chaining.md` plus the code.

The ext/Doc architecture doc is written and committed in the worktree (commit `1c760b285`).

- **File:** `public/framework/ext/Doc/doc/architecture.md`, 77 lines, 11 decisions, each checked against `Doc.js`.
- **Also changed:** `readme.md` gets the `doc/architecture.md` link under `## More`, and `page.js` adds `architecture` to its `notes:` list.
- **Code mismatches:** none found, so there are no `⚠` lines. I dropped two entries (the `is_class` source-text check and the `docs` → `doc` redirect) to get under 80 lines; both are still covered in `doc/decisions.md`.

`doc/files.jsonl` shows as modified in the tree, but it is not mine and I did not commit it.

I wrote and committed `core/Events` architecture doc in the worktree (commit fe8bc5f89).

- **File:** `public/framework/core/Events/doc/architecture.md`, 48 lines. The readme's `## More` line now links to it.
- **⚠ Code mismatches:**
  - No class overrides `bubbles()`, so the readme's claim that `core/Page` stops events at the page is false.
  - `List` extends `Item`, not `Events(Object)` directly as the readme says.
- **Not done:** the census returned no decision lines for `core/Events`, so the doc is written from the code. No `page.js` notes entry, since Events has no page.js. I did not touch the readme's wrong lines because the fence excludes them; they need the mastermind's fix.

Wrote and committed `ext/Saver` architecture doc in the worktree (commits `31c455c96`, `0a4d50a76`).

1. `public/framework/ext/Saver/doc/architecture.md`: 80 lines, nine decisions checked against `Saver.js`, `FileSaver.js`, `LocalStorageSaver.js`, `MemorySaver.js` and `Prefs.js`.
2. Readme `More` gets a `doc/architecture.md` link as its own bullet rather than appended to the existing line, and `page.js` notes gained `architecture`. Both `node --check` clean.
3. ⚠ one mismatch: `backends.md` says "off localhost" for the warn-once behaviour, but the code gates on `edit()` from `ext/Ask`. The architecture doc records the code's behaviour and flags this.

`ext/grip/doc/architecture.md` is committed on the worktree branch (commit `9890d26d8`).

- **File:** `public/framework/ext/grip/doc/architecture.md`, 77 lines. The readme `## More` line and the `page.js` notes (`decisions architecture`) are updated in the same commit.
- **Code mismatches (`⚠`):** none. Every entry was checked against `grip.js` and `grip.css`. The older "wholly inside the box" fact in `decisions.md` is superseded by the two-zones rule, and the doc states the current rule.
- **Not mine:** `doc/files.jsonl` shows as modified in the worktree. I did not touch it and left it uncommitted.

Wrote `ext/layout/doc/architecture.md` (73 lines) and committed it in the worktree as `0de67bee3`, with the readme `More` link and the `architecture` page note.

⚠ One code mismatch: the drawer is no longer drawn by this module. `ext/drawer` owns the push now, and `doc/drawer.md` still says `panel.js` writes `--drawer`. That doc is outside my fence, so it is flagged inline rather than fixed.

The census returned no decision lines for `ext/layout`, so the entries come from `doc/decisions.md` and the code.

The architecture doc for `ui/tree` is written and committed in the worktree (commit `1c23e6d83`).

- **File:** `public/framework/ui/tree/doc/architecture.md`, 56 lines.
- **Readme:** added the `More` link to `doc/architecture.md`; the other lines are untouched.
- **Code mismatches:** none. Each entry was checked against `tree.js`, `ux/Tree/Tree.js` and `framework.css:638`. I left out the `t.update()` decision because its class method no longer exists.
- **Not done:** `ui/tree/page.js` has no `notes:` list, so I did not add an `architecture` entry there.

Wrote and committed `public/framework/ui/field/doc/architecture.md` (38 lines, commit 865fa1b79 in the worktree).

- The readme gets a `## More` line linking it. The page has no `notes:` list, so I left `page.js` alone.
- ⚠ The page claims the base layer pads and borders text controls. I found the width rule in `styles/layers/base/page.js` but not the padding or border rule, so that claim is unverified.

Wrote and committed `ux/Tree` architecture doc (`b34ba1e28`, in the worktree only).

- **File:** `public/framework/ux/Tree/doc/architecture.md`, 77 lines.
- **Also changed:** readme `## More` gets the architecture link; `page.js` notes now read `decisions architecture`.
- **⚠ Code mismatch:** the decisions log names a `.ux-tree-keys .ui-tree-row:focus` rule that no longer exists in any CSS file. The doc flags it and says the focus ring comes from `ui/tree`.

Wrote `public/web/nav/doc/architecture.md` (82 lines), committed as `048b67ea3` in the worktree.

⚠ Two stale readme claims: the rail's thumb ceiling is now `--thumb-max: 4em` (not 10em), and `web()` has no url-based default root title (its site title is "Aurora").

`readme.md` gets the `## More` line (created, since none existed); `page.js` has no `notes:` list, so it is untouched.
